subject: Security discovery follow-up — logs, backups, and questionnaire routing
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Collins <ava.collins@healthsync.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security discovery follow-up — logs, backups, and questionnaire routing

Hi Ava — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so your team can validate: 

1) SOC 2 status
- Redwood is currently in SOC 2 Type II readiness; controls have been through initial audits and we expect Type II report issuance in Q3 2027. We can share the Type I report and our control mapping now (attached).

2) GDPR / HIPAA considerations
- We support data processing agreements and required contractual terms. For PHI workloads we recommend Private or Dedicated deployment for isolation and custom KMS.

3) Logs & backups (items we discussed) — please confirm your required windows but suggested defaults: 
- Application logs (structured request/response): 90 days
- Audit logs (admin actions, config changes): 7 years (can be reduced for non-regulated customers)
- Backup snapshots: standard retention 365 days for DR; configurable per-customer for Dedicated/Private

4) Deletion flow
- Logical deletion from live indexes within 24 hours of a valid request.
- Backups: dependent on backup retention window — typical timeframe to purge from backups is 30–90 days unless legal hold applies. We can provide a targeted purge process for PHI if needed.

Attachments: vendor-security-questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx), initial-security-profile.pdf (pdf)

Proposed next steps: 
- Can you route your security questionnaire to security@healthsync.com (per your team) so we can track responses?
- Camila (cc’d) can share a backup retention matrix and a short note on the deletion lifecycle.
- If acceptable, let’s schedule a 30-minute session for your infosec team (Camila + our security engineer) Tuesday or Wednesday next week — 9:00–11:00 PT windows work for us.

Thanks — looking forward to closing these questions so we can move towards the POC.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0193

From: Ava Collins <ava.collins@healthsync.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@healthsync.com
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 17:38:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Security discovery follow-up — logs, backups, and questionnaire routing

Thanks Logan — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2: sharing the Type I and the control mapping now would be ideal. We'll need the Type II once available but can proceed with assessments in parallel.

- Deletion requirement: for any PHI objects we need confirmation that once a deletion request is actioned the customer can expect removal from all live systems within 24 hours and from all backups within a maximum of 30 days — our compliance team has a hard requirement of 30 days for backup purge on sensitive datasets (unless we explicitly agree to a longer DR window). Is there a path to a contractual SLA for that behavior?

- Backups: HealthSync typically requires a shorter backup retention option for certain datasets; can Redwood provide a policy/configuration that keeps snapshots for 30 days for those datasets?

- Questionnaire: forwarding HealthSync's infosec alias (security@healthsync.com) on this thread — please send completed questionnaire responses there. We'll also be sending our updated questionnaire shortly.

Can Camila confirm the deletion timelines and whether Redwood can support the 30-day backup purge SLA for PHI (we're flexible if the contract specifies conditions/limitations)?

Best,
Ava Collins
Head of Security & Privacy, HealthSync
ava.collins@healthsync.com
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Collins <ava.collins@healthsync.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 09:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security discovery follow-up — logs, backups, and questionnaire routing

On Mon, Apr 5, 2027 at 3:12 PM Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Ava — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so your team can validate: ...

Hi Ava — Camila here (solutions engineering). Short answers + implementation options below.

1) SOC 2
- We can provide the Type I report and our control mapping now (see attached initial-security-profile.pdf). Type II expected Q3 2027; we'll commit to delivering that when available and can include it as a contract exhibit if needed.

2) Deletion lifecycle and backups (concrete paths):
- Live deletion: confirmed — logical delete from service indexes and API-visible state within 24 hours of an authenticated deletion request.
- Backup retention and purge: two models depending on deployment:
  a) Hosted (standard): default snapshot retention is 365 days. For enterprise customers we offer configurable shorter retention for specific datasets (e.g., PHI) down to 30 days, but it requires a documented configuration and may incur adjustments to our DR posture.
  b) Dedicated / Private: you control snapshot schedules and retention in your environment; Redwood's private package supports customer-configured 30-day snapshot retention and expedited purge options.
- Permanent purge from backups: for hosted customers, we run weekly retention sweeps; expected window to remove a deleted object from all backup stores is typically 30–90 days depending on snapshot timing. We can include a contractual SLA to target 30 days for PHI if you accept the narrower DR window and specify scope (which datasets, whether legal holds apply).

3) Targeted purge process
- We have a defined support-operated purge that can be executed for PHI with verification and audit logs. Execution requires a signed DSR/POA and will produce an audit artifact. Lead time is usually 5–10 business days depending on complexity.

4) Attachments and mapping
- Attached: backup-retention-matrix.csv (matrix of retention options by deployment and dataset type).
- We'll also return the vendor Q.xlsx with sections completed. Please confirm whether HealthSync requires an encrypted channel or upload to your secure portal for completed questionnaire items.

Next steps / asks:
- Ava/security@healthsync.com: confirm whether you need a contractual SLA for 30-day backup purge for PHI and whether that will be limited to a named dataset scope.
- If yes, we'll prepare a short SLA exhibit and technical annex outlining tradeoffs (DR windows, snapshot frequency).
- Propose short technical call with our security engineer and your team: Wed 04/07 10:00–10:30 PT or Thu 04/08 09:00–09:30 PT. Please pick one and we will calendar.

Attachments: backup-retention-matrix.csv

Thanks — happy to walk through the matrix and the purge workflow on the call.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai
From: Ava Collins <ava.collins@healthsync.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@healthsync.com
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Security discovery follow-up — logs, backups, and questionnaire routing

Camila / Logan — thanks for the clear options. We can accept a contractual SLA that specifies a 30-day backup purge for a scoped set of PHI datasets (we'll provide the dataset identifiers). We understand the DR tradeoffs and will document the acceptable snapshot cadence.

We'd like to take the Wed 04/07 10:00 PT slot for the call with your security engineer — please send calendar invite and dial-in.

Also attaching HealthSync-Questionnaire-v2.pdf for your reference — we'll expect your completed sections uploaded to our secure portal (I will send upload instructions separately to security@healthsync.com).

Thanks,
Ava
Head of Security & Privacy, HealthSync
ava.collins@healthsync.com
